title: Precipitation Downscaling Using Foundation Model-Conditioned Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2608.25858v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-resolution precipitation fields are essential for hydrological impact assessment, yet global climate model outputs are too coarse and biased for direct use. AI-based statistical downscaling with diffusion models offers a promising approach, but the mechanism by which large-scale atmospheric predictors condition generation remains largely unexplored. We investigate three conditioning strategies for a denoising diffusion probabilistic model applied to daily precipitation downscaling: channel concatenation of upsampled coarse predictors, cross-attention conditioning with a learned convolutional encoder, and cross-attention conditioning with the frozen encoder of the pretrained Prithvi WxC weather foundation model. All strategies are evaluated against an unconditioned baseline under identical conditions using probabilistic, distributional, spectral, and extreme-event metrics for the Colorado River Basin. translated_title: 基于基础模型条件扩散的降水降尺度方法
translated_abstract: 高分辨率的降水场对于水文影响评估至关重要，但全球气候模型的输出过于粗糙且存在偏差，无法直接使用。基于扩散模型的AI统计降尺度方法提供了一种有前景的途径，然而，大规模大气预测因子如何调节生成过程的机制仍鲜有探索。我们研究了三种应用于日降水降尺度的去噪扩散概率模型的条件化策略：粗预测因子上采样后的通道拼接、使用学习型卷积编码器的交叉注意力条件化，以及使用预训练Prithvi WxC天气基础模型的冻结编码器的交叉注意力条件化。所有策略均在相同条件下与无条件基线进行了评估，采用概率、分布、频谱和极端事件指标，针对科罗拉多河流域。拼接条件化在性能上取得了最佳效果。
tldr: 本文系统比较了三种条件化策略在降水降尺度扩散模型中的效果，发现通道拼接方法最优，并揭示了基础模型编码器在极端事件捕捉中的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares three conditioning strategies for diffusion-based precipitation downscaling, finding channel concatenation optimal and revealing limitations of foundation model encoders in capturing extreme events.
